name: Amprius Technologies
about:
Amprius Technologies was founded in 2008 in Fremont, California. The company completed its initial public offering in 2022 and trades on the NYSE; it is led by Chief Executive Officer Tom Stepien, who joined the board in 2025. No founder names are disclosed in public materials.

The company manufactures high-energy-density silicon-nanowire-anode lithium-ion battery cells under the SiCore product line. Production occurs at an MWh-scale facility in Fremont, supplemented by GWh-scale contract manufacturing partnerships in China, with plans to expand across Asia and Europe. The operation supports cell design, anode fabrication, and pack integration for high-performance applications.

Amprius serves unmanned aviation, manned aviation, light electric vehicles, electric vehicles, and AI and robotics sectors. Customers include Nokia Drone Networks, which integrates SiCore batteries into its drone networks, and stratospheric platform developers Prismatic (PHASA-35) and AALTO, which rely on the cells for extended endurance and high-latitude coverage.

The company was established to overcome the energy-density limits of conventional graphite anodes by commercializing silicon nanowire technology. Amprius states its patented cells deliver the highest energy density on the market, enabling longer range, faster charging, and operation across a wide temperature range for mission-critical systems.
